description: RimWorld actor tenant composed from the shared Glue actor manifest and canonical actor seed domains. Glue selects declarative candidates and workflows; RimWorld remains authoritative for Pawn facts, job legality, reservations, reachability, save lifecycle, and native execution.

universalDomains.purpose: identity, traits, needs, mood, position, timing
skill levels, learning, qualification, and work gates
universalDomains.nativeAuthority: RimWorld skill and work systems decide qualification and work assignment

universalDomains.purpose: wounds, conditions, pain, treatment, and recovery
universalDomains.nativeAuthority: Hediff, treatment, tending, and medical job admission remain native

universalDomains.purpose: items, capacity, hauling, stockpiles, reservations, and transfer workflows
universalDomains.nativeAuthority: Storage acceptance, reservation, pathing, and JobDriver execution remain native

universalDomains.purpose: relationships, factions, roles, incidents, obligations, and multi-actor workflows
universalDomains.nativeAuthority: Thoughts, relations, faction state, lord jobs, and storyteller events remain native

universalDomains.purpose: rooms, weather, danger, alarms, defense, and breach response
universalDomains.nativeAuthority: Room membership, region reachability, threats, and combat jobs remain native

universalDomains.purpose: recipes, workshops, research gates, work queues, and production obligations
universalDomains.nativeAuthority: Bill ingredient search, reservations, recipe legality, and job execution remain native

rimworldExtensions.adapterBoundary: GlueRimworld C# observes native facts, filters declared candidates, requests native admission, and records receipts; it does not score gameplay or own persistence
Workshop mechanics are source-backed projection targets and compatibility evidence, never bundled implementation

crossRuntimeParity.requiredProof: same component-tree and receipt vocabulary with runtime-specific native evidence; never byte-identical gameplay state

syncPolicy.nativePackagePolicy: copy-or-generate only through a declared build manifest; never hand-edit mirrored shared seeds
syncPolicy.unsupportedBehavior: remain declared but fail closed until a native admission and readback contract exists
